title: Unit-normalized symmetric tensor comparison and total summand equations
statement: Let X be a scheme and U an open [def-pc-scheme], L the functor of Modules.overEquiv U and T its degreewise cochain functor. There exists a symmetric core monoidal structure m on L with unit isomorphism equal to overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U. For all integer cochain complexes P,F on the over-U site let D=Hom(P,O[0]) be the ordinary dual [def-pc-ordinary-evaluation-data]. There is an isomorphism c:T(Tot(F tensor D)) to Tot(TF tensor TD) [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. For every p+q=n its component satisfies L(iota_F,D,p,q,n);c^n = m.mu(F^p,D^q)^(-1);iota_TF,TD,p,q,n. Symmetry is the equality L(beta_A,B);m.mu(B,A)^(-1)=m.mu(A,B)^(-1);beta_LA,LB for all module sheaves A,B. There are no boundedness or homological hypotheses.

proof.text: Construct the coefficient-compatible presheaf reindexing tensorator on pure tensors. Descend it through sheafification, using the open-site sheafification comparison. Balanced relations and associativity of tensor products prove the core monoidal laws. Interchanging the pure factors proves symmetry. On the unit this reindexing is precisely the structure-sheaf restriction isomorphism overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso, so its unit is the prescribed one. This is a direct construction, not selection of a witness from a bare existence assertion.

Use the inverse tensorator in each bidegree. Naturality makes it commute with each differential, so two isoOfComponents constructions give a bicomplex isomorphism. The equivalence preserves coproducts. Compose inverse mapTotalIso with total.mapIso of this bicomplex isomorphism. The map_ι_mapTotalXIso_inv and total inclusion naturality equations identify the image of each summand with the inverse tensorator followed by the target inclusion. These APIs also account for the signed vertical differential; no boundedness is needed.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_ordinaryEvaluation_tensor_summands (X : Scheme.{u}) (U : X.Opens) :
    let L := Equivalence.functor
      (C := localEvaluationModules X U)
      (D := SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace))
      (Scheme.Modules.overEquiv U)
    let T := L.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    ∃ m : L.CoreMonoidal,
      m.εIso = Scheme.Modules.overEquivFunctorObjUnitIso U ∧
      (∀ A B : localEvaluationModules X U,
        L.map (β_ A B).hom ≫ (m.μIso B A).inv =
          (m.μIso A B).inv ≫ (β_ (L.obj A) (L.obj B)).hom) ∧
      ∀ P F : CochainComplex (localEvaluationModules X U) ℤ,
        ∃ c : T.obj (localEvaluationTensor X U P F) ≅
            pullbackTensorTotal U.toScheme (T.obj F) (T.obj (localEvaluationDual X U P)),
          ∀ (p q n : ℤ) (h : p + q = n),
            L.map (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor F (localEvaluationDual X U P)
                (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h) ≫ c.hom.f n =
              (m.μIso (F.X p) ((localEvaluationDual X U P).X q)).inv ≫
                HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor (T.obj F)
                  (T.obj (localEvaluationDual X U P)) (curriedTensor _) (.up ℤ) p q n h
